originStory.title: Why I Created Clarity 101
originStory.subtitle: From 15 Years on Rails to Designing My Own Path
originStory.story: For **15 years**, I worked as a software developer, then project manager. I found satisfaction in my work. I was learning, growing, building things. But there was this nagging feeling I couldn't shake: I wasn't exploring all my options. I wasn't fully taking advantage of my curiosity. For years, I didn't consider this a problem. The fulfillment from projects kept me going. Until one day, after conversations with colleagues and friends, I realized: staying on those rails was actually the problem I needed to solve. That realization changed everything. It led me to create my own company, start consulting, write books, build products, and eventually coach others. Today, I feel much happier than I was before. This workshop shares the exact framework that helped me, and now helps others, move from feeling stuck to designing intentional lives.
originStory.inspirationPoint: You cannot solve a problem you're not willing to have. Once I accepted that staying comfortable was actually my problem, everything changed.

creatorJourney.title: From Software Developer to Life Designer
creatorJourney.subtitle: 20+ Years of Learning How to Live Intentionally
creatorJourney.story: I'm **40+**, and I've lived different lives. Software developer. Author. Entrepreneur. Coach. Father of three. Each evolution taught me something crucial about clarity. I present this with humility. I don't consider myself in a position to tell people how to live their lives. To each their own. I just want to share what has worked for me, what has helped me live a happier life. These ideas are also part of the [Knowledge Worker Kit](/product/knowledge-worker-kit), where clarity is the first and most important section. Because whether you're choosing a career, starting a project, or deciding who to work with, clarity is what you need.

Had to accept that comfort can be a problem to solve
Learned that alignment between work and life is essential for happiness
achievements: Built a company that lets me explore my curiosity
Written multiple books on knowledge management and software

methodology.title: The Clarity Framework
methodology.subtitle: A *Design Thinking* Approach to Life

steps.title: Accept Your Gravity Problems
steps.description: Identify the problems in your life that you haven't accepted yet. You cannot solve a problem you're not willing to have. This is where change begins.

steps.title: Map Values to Needs
steps.description: Uncover your core values and connect them to your actual needs. Your values act as guides for decision-making. Your needs must be satisfied for happiness.

steps.title: Create Your Personal Manifesto
steps.description: Combine your values, principles, and beliefs into a guiding document. This becomes your **north star** for every major decision.

steps.title: Find Your *Ikigai*
steps.description: Discover the intersection of what you love, what you're good at, what the world needs, and what you can be paid for. Your reason for being.

steps.title: Design and Prototype Futures
steps.description: Use *Design Thinking* to envision multiple possible futures. Create **Vision Grids**. Prototype through conversations and experiences before committing.

steps.title: Set Goals and Priorities
steps.description: Use **Reverse Goal Setting** and *SMART Goals* across different time horizons. Focus on your **top 3 priorities** based on impact.

methodology.philosophy: Clarity isn't about having all the answers. It's about having the right **framework** to find your own answers, make aligned decisions, and design a life that feels great. Not just looks good.
methodology.differentiation: Unlike generic goal-setting advice, this framework starts with **values and principles FIRST**. Goals without clarity are just wishes. Clarity makes your goals meaningful.

vision.title: Why Clarity Matters
vision.subtitle: The Foundation of Everything
vision.mission: To help people move from **reactive** living to **intentional** design. Because everyone deserves to design a life that aligns with who they truly are. Not who society expects them to be.

values.title: Happiness First
values.description: Career is important, but it's secondary to **happiness**, **freedom**, and **family**. Alignment across all of these is what creates a fulfilling life.

values.title: Action Over Perfection
values.description: You don't need perfect clarity to start. Think of your life as an **experiment**. Set the bar low, try stuff, learn, try again.

values.title: Your Own Path
values.description: I don't tell people how to live their lives. To each their own. I share what has worked for me, and you adapt it to your situation.

futureGoals: Help more people escape the trap of reactive living
Build systems that make clarity accessible to everyone
Create a community of intentional life designers
vision.biggerPicture: Clarity is just the first step. Once you have clarity, you need a **SYSTEM** to turn it into reality. That's what the [Knowledge Worker Kit](/product/knowledge-worker-kit) and the [Knowii Community](/product/knowii-community) are for. But it all starts here. With clarity.
